description: Source code for the 'git grep' command implementation, including threading, submodule handling, and pattern matching logic.

classes.name: work_item
classes.description: Structure representing a unit of work for grep threading, containing source info, completion status, and output buffer.

methods.name: add_work
methods.description: Adds a work item to the thread queue, loading driver if necessary.

methods.name: get_work
methods.description: Retrieves the next work item from the queue for processing.

methods.name: work_done
methods.description: Marks a work item as completed, outputs results, and signals threads.

methods.name: free_repos
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for submodule repositories.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Thread worker function executing grep source processing.

methods.name: strbuf_out
methods.description: Callback to append data to the current work item's output buffer.

methods.name: start_threads
methods.description: Initializes threading environment and starts worker threads.

methods.name: wait_all
methods.description: Waits for all threads to complete processing.

methods.name: grep_cmd_config
methods.description: Handles configuration options for grep, including thread count and recurse settings.

methods.name: grep_source_name
methods.description: Generates a filename source string for grep, considering relative and prefix options.

methods.name: grep_oid
methods.description: Processes a given object ID for grep, possibly adding work for threading.

methods.name: grep_file
methods.description: Processes a filename for grep, possibly adding work for threading.

methods.name: append_path
methods.description: Appends a path component to the output list.

methods.name: run_pager
methods.description: Executes the pager command with the list of matched files.

methods.name: grep_cache
methods.description: Grep implementation for cached index data.

methods.name: grep_tree
methods.description: Recursive function to grep through a tree object.

methods.name: grep_object
methods.description: Grep implementation for a generic object.

methods.name: grep_objects
methods.description: Grep implementation for an array of objects.

methods.name: grep_directory
methods.description: Grep implementation for directory traversal.

methods.name: context_callback
methods.description: Handles context line options for grep.

methods.name: file_callback
methods.description: Handles pattern input from files.

methods.name: not_callback
methods.description: Handles --not pattern option.

methods.name: and_callback
methods.description: Handles --and pattern option.

methods.name: open_callback
methods.description: Handles open parenthesis pattern option.

methods.name: close_callback
methods.description: Handles close parenthesis pattern option.

methods.name: pattern_callback
methods.description: Handles pattern input from -e option.
